description: Create, update, and remove public IPs. This module has a dependency on 1and1 >= 1.0.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: Custom API URL. Overrides the ONEANDONE_API_URL environment variable.

parameters.name: datacenter
parameters.description: ID of the datacenter where the IP is created (only for unassigned IPs). Choices: "US" ← (default) "ES" "DE" "GB"

parameters.name: public_ip_id
parameters.description: The ID of the public IP used with update and delete states.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Define a public IP state to create, remove, or update. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent" "update"

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type of IP. Currently, only IPV4 is available. Choices: "IPV4" ← (default) "IPV6"

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Wait for the instance to be in state ‘running’ before returning. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: wait_interval
parameters.description: Defines the number of seconds to wait when using the _wait_for methods. Default: 5

parameters.name: wait_timeout
parameters.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds. Default: 600

examples:
- name: Create a public IP
  community.general.oneandone_public_ip:
    auth_token: oneandone_private_api_key
    reverse_dns: example.com
    datacenter: US
    type: IPV4

- name: Update a public IP
  community.general.oneandone_public_ip:
    auth_token: oneandone_private_api_key
    public_ip_id: public ip id
    reverse_dns: secondexample.com
    state: update

- name: Delete a public IP
  community.general.oneandone_public_ip:
    auth_token: oneandone_private_api_key
    public_ip_id: public ip id
    state: absent

return_values.name: public_ip
return_values.description: Information about the public IP that was processed. Returned: always Sample: {"id": "F77CC589EBC120905B4F4719217BFF6D", "ip": "10.5.132.106"}
